rose-quartz.name: Rose Quartz
rose-quartz.title: The Love Stone
rose-quartz.story: A pink variety of quartz whose soft rosy colour comes from microscopic mineral inclusions within the crystal. Treasured throughout history as a symbol of love, rose quartz is associated with compassion, self-love and emotional harmony. Star rose quartz is rarer still: tiny aligned inclusions create a gentle star of light that appears when the bead catches the sun.
rose-quartz.wear: Traditionally worn on the left wrist, closest to the heart, to receive its gentle energy. Ideal for everyday wear and for anyone healing, opening up to love, or learning to be kinder to themselves.
rose-quartz.real: Natural rose quartz has a soft, slightly milky glow and small natural clouds. Perfectly clear, bubble-filled beads are usually glass, and colour that gathers in cracks is a sign of dye.
forYou: Are healing your heart or opening up to love
Want to be kinder and gentler with yourself
Seek calm in relationships and family life
Are looking for a meaningful gift for someone you love

strawberry-quartz.name: Strawberry Quartz
strawberry-quartz.title: The Stone of Joyful Love
strawberry-quartz.story: Clear quartz speckled with tiny red mineral inclusions that look like the seeds of a strawberry. It is associated with warmth, romance and a light, joyful heart, and is loved for bringing playfulness back into relationships.
strawberry-quartz.wear: Wear it when you want to attract love or rekindle warmth in a relationship. Pairs beautifully with rose quartz.
strawberry-quartz.real: Look closely: real strawberry quartz shows individual red flecks floating inside clear quartz. Evenly bright red beads with no visible inclusions are usually dyed quartz or glass.
forYou: Want to attract romance or rekindle warmth
Need more joy and lightness day to day
Love wearing colour with meaning
Pair crystals with rose quartz for love

amethyst.name: Amethyst
amethyst.title: The Stone of Calm
amethyst.story: A violet variety of quartz known for its calming appearance. Amethyst is often associated with balance, intuition and inner peace, and has long been kept close for restful sleep and a quieter mind.
amethyst.wear: Lovely for busy minds and stressful days. Many keep amethyst near the bed at night or wear it while meditating.
amethyst.real: Natural amethyst shows colour zoning: bands of lighter and deeper purple within a bead. Perfectly uniform, intensely purple beads deserve a second look.
forYou: Have a busy, overthinking mind
Want more restful sleep and calm evenings
Meditate or are starting a spiritual practice
Seek balance during stressful seasons

rainbow-tourmaline.name: Rainbow Tourmaline
rainbow-tourmaline.title: The Stone of Creativity
rainbow-tourmaline.story: A colourful variety of tourmaline in which each bead carries its own combination of pink, green, yellow and peach. Rainbow tourmaline symbolises creativity, positivity and vibrant energy, with every strand completely one of a kind.
rainbow-tourmaline.wear: A joyful everyday piece for creatives and anyone who wants more colour and abundance in their life.
rainbow-tourmaline.real: Real rainbow tourmaline varies from bead to bead in colour and clarity, with natural inclusions. Matching, candy-bright beads are often dyed jade or glass.
forYou: Work in creative fields
Want to invite abundance and positivity
Love one-of-a-kind, colourful pieces
Need a joyful everyday bracelet

sunstone.name: Sunstone
sunstone.title: The Stone of Joy & Abundance
sunstone.story: A variety of feldspar known for its warm golden-orange glow and sparkling aventurescence, created by tiny reflective inclusions of minerals such as hematite or goethite. Its radiant appearance resembles sunlight, making it a symbol of positivity, confidence and vitality.
sunstone.wear: Suitable for everyday wear with proper care. Wear it when you need a lift in mood, motivation or self-belief.
sunstone.real: Natural sunstone sparkles irregularly when turned in the light. 'Goldstone' — man-made glass with evenly spread copper glitter — is often sold as sunstone.
forYou: Want a lift in mood and motivation
Are stepping into leadership or a new role
Need confidence for big presentations
Love warm, sparkling tones

tiger-eye.name: Tiger Eye
tiger-eye.title: The Stone of Courage
tiger-eye.story: Its unique silky appearance is created by fibrous mineral inclusions within the crystal, producing a band of light that moves like the eye of a tiger. Tiger eye is often associated with confidence, strength and grounding energy.
tiger-eye.wear: A favourite for work, exams and big decisions. Wear it when you need to stand firm and act with confidence.
tiger-eye.real: Turn a real tiger eye bead slowly: the golden shimmer glides across the surface. Glass 'cat's eye' imitations have rigid, perfectly regular stripes.
forYou: Face exams, interviews or big decisions
Want to stand firm and act with courage
Need focus and grounding at work
Prefer earthy, understated jewellery

phantom-quartz.name: Phantom Quartz
phantom-quartz.title: The Stone of Growth & Transformation
phantom-quartz.story: A variety of quartz distinguished by its internal 'phantom' formations, created when earlier crystal growth was covered by a later layer of quartz over time. These ghost-like inclusions record the crystal's natural growth journey, symbolising evolution, renewal and transformation.

facts.Colour: Clear with green, red or white phantoms

phantom-quartz.wear: Durable enough for everyday wear. Meaningful for new chapters — a new job, a move, or letting go of the past.
phantom-quartz.real: The phantoms in natural stones look like soft, layered gardens or mountains inside each bead, and no two are the same.
forYou: Are beginning a new chapter in life
Want to let go of the past and grow
Value pieces with a natural story inside
Seek steady personal transformation

black-tourmaline.name: Black Tourmaline
black-tourmaline.title: The Stone of Protection
black-tourmaline.story: One of October's month stones of transformation and protection. Deep black tourmaline has long been associated with grounding and with shielding its wearer from negative energy.
black-tourmaline.wear: Often worn on the right wrist or carried in crowded, high-pressure places to stay grounded.
black-tourmaline.real: Natural black tourmaline is opaque with fine striations and a slightly uneven lustre. Overly glassy, perfectly smooth black beads are often obsidian or glass.
forYou: Work in crowded or high-pressure places
Feel easily drained by other people's energy
Want a grounding, protective everyday piece
Are going through a period of change

rutilated-quartz.name: Golden Rutilated Quartz
rutilated-quartz.title: The Stone of Wealth & Light
rutilated-quartz.story: You might think the golden lines inside are scratches — they are needles of rutile that grew naturally inside clear quartz. Prized across Asia as a stone of prosperity, it is associated with abundance, energy and attracting opportunity.
rutilated-quartz.wear: Displayed in the home or office — many place it in the wealth corner (far left from the entrance) to invite prosperity.
rutilated-quartz.real: Real rutile needles vary in thickness, angle and length and sit at different depths. Painted-looking, evenly spaced lines suggest an imitation.
forYou: Want to invite prosperity into home or office
Are building a business or career
Love rare, statement crystals
Practise feng shui

clear-quartz.name: Clear Quartz
clear-quartz.title: The Master Healer
clear-quartz.story: Clear quartz is known as the master healer — a versatile stone associated with clarity of mind and amplifying intention. Lit from below, a sphere fills the room with soft, calming light.
clear-quartz.wear: Placed in a living room, study or meditation corner. Set an intention while holding it before placing it on its stand.
clear-quartz.real: Natural quartz feels cool and heavy and usually holds faint clouds or fractures. Glass often contains round bubbles and warms quickly in the hand.
forYou: Want a calm, light-filled corner at home
Meditate or set daily intentions
Need clarity and focus while working
Are new to crystals and want a versatile first piece
